source_of_claim: User-supplied F0 archive; definitions and proved propositions formalized separately from finite checks and conjectures.
conditions: K is idempotent; fixed points and fibers are actual subtypes, with an explicit fiber decomposition equivalence.
A means C(S(x))=x. B means S(K(x))(i)=K(S(x)(i)). T=K(C(liftK K (S x))).
The indistinguishability converse requires a nonempty output index type I.
Finite orbit conclusions require Fintype alpha; a period bound requires distinct points within the stated positive period.
Compatible-map counts require finite alpha and finite I; they count S for a fixed K, without imposing A or injectivity.
Rank counts concern all labelled idempotent maps with r fixed points. The all-ranks sum includes r=0, which also handles the empty base type.
Merge reachability assumes a nonempty multiset of positive natural numbers. All-ones reachability assumes N>0.
The Chebyshev bridge reuses the exact prior representative maps for degree 2*m+1 and proves equality of their kernels with candidate equality.
excluded: A general Lean proof of the type-specific factorial count N!/(product_i (m_i-1)! product_s c_s!).
A general proof or counterexample for strict imbalance monotonicity; the supplied 528 finite checks are retained.
Realization of every integer-partition merge edge by specified S,C maps, or counting distinct transition maps T.
A structural identification of 34634 or 34643 with F0; finite coefficient calculations do not establish one.
Probability weights, Bayesian update compatibility, human prediction or ARC policy performance.
